###### our company

# Building the infrastructure for embedded insurance.

Vertical Insure helps software platforms turn protection into a natural part of the customer experience. By combining technology and insurance expertise, we’re making coverage accessible at the moment it matters most – directly within the platforms users are already familiar with.

[Talk to our Team](https://verticalinsure.com/contact-us/)

###### our mission

## Make protection accessible with every purchase.

Insurance has traditionally been complicated, disconnected, and difficult to access. Customers are forced to leave the platforms they trust, navigate unfamiliar processes, and purchase protection separately from the products and services they rely on.

We believe there’s a better way.

Our mission is to make coverage accessible with every purchase by helping software platforms offer tailored protection directly within their existing experiences. The result is a simpler customer journey, stronger businesses, and more people protected when it matters most.

###### the opportunity

## Software is changing how protection is delivered.

We’re helping platforms transform insurance from a disconnected afterthought into a built-in part of the customer experience. By leveraging industry-specific data and workflows, coverage becomes easier to understand, simpler to purchase, and more relevant to the people who need it.
